purpose: Calculates a fraud score for payments to determine if a payment is risky, allowing, reviewing, or blocking based on the score.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: MSK is managed Kafka. Think of Kafka as a conveyor belt: services put messages on it, other services take them off.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: It reads each event, applies the rules and the model and makes a decision.

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: The engine writes every decision here, together with the customer attributes it used.

flows.evidence: First, payment-events delivers the event to the scoring-engine.
Second, the scoring-engine writes the risk decision to decisions-db.
Third, the scoring-engine writes an audit record to the scoring audit log group.
